scope: Local backend / XFS / warm page cache / release / 4 runtime workers; no network backend performance claim
verdict: 82/82 acceptance checks passed; full payload verification passed for every run

root_causes.cause: Unconditional timer creation and repaying elapsed IO time
root_causes.evidence: 8 MiB reproduction: high QoS 789.99 IOPS vs unlimited 10741.42; strict 109.72 / 128. Paused-clock regression charged another 8 ms after 20 ms of source IO.
root_causes.fix: Compare strict and hard intervals with the last actual admission, count elapsed IO, and skip waiting when the deadline has passed. Keep actual release timestamps to prohibit accumulated catch-up slots.
root_causes.differential_result: Changing only this scheduling rule brought high QoS to 95.7% of its paired baseline; strict QoS remained at 87.1%.

root_causes.cause: Coarse timer wakeup latency accumulates under strict minimum spacing
root_causes.evidence: After the elapsed-IO fix, 128 IOPS still measured 111.50. With only precise waiting changed, it measured 125.69 (98.2%).
root_causes.fix: Use the async timer for long waits and OS sleep on a blocking worker only for the final <=2 ms. Runtime workers never sleep or busy-spin. Outer cancellation remains immediate; detached tail work is bounded.
root_causes.cpu_observation: Across three 8 MiB strict runs, measured child CPU was 0.143 seconds before and 0.149 seconds after precision waiting; timings include setup and full hashing.

root_causes.cause: Soft credit was not replenished during hard or combined-resource waits
root_causes.evidence: The deterministic dual bandwidth/IOPS peak regression took 700 ms instead of approximately 500 ms.
root_causes.fix: Refill from the scheduler observation through actual admission, charge the packet, then cap remaining credit. Both resources share a maximum deadline, so waiting for either refills both.

measurement_correction.cause: Read completion spacing can compress when source IO latency varies; it is not admission spacing.
measurement_correction.fix: Keep completion events, add exact admission timestamps under the scheduler lock, validate original hard/soft envelopes on admissions for BOTH serial reads and concurrent copies. Require trace counts and byte totals to match charged counters and verified payload.
measurement_correction.thresholds: No loosened rate ceilings or 95% floors. Hard envelope remains hard*duration plus one actual IO packet; soft envelope adds bounded configured credit.
measurement_correction.production_impact: Tracing only exists with test-support/qos-diagnostics and must be enabled explicitly for finite workloads.

precision_correction: Hard service intervals use integer ceil-to-nanosecond arithmetic, preventing fractional-nanosecond rounding below the configured minimum interval.
